neighbours.label: the token right before a plot/graph is named (e.g. ' a' in 'make a graph', 'on a logarithmic scale' when plotting): anticipates a chart word
fire: For the homework, please draw a scatter plot of rainfall against crop yield.
The analyst decided to show the trend with a line graph of monthly sales.
We plotted the enzyme activity on a logarithmic axis to compare the samples.
Using matplotlib, she created a bar chart of the survey responses.
Students should sketch a graph of velocity versus time for the falling ball.
The report includes a histogram of patient ages at diagnosis.
To compare the groups, he made a box plot of the reaction times.
The software lets you visualize the relationship with a heat map of correlations.
quiet: For the homework, please write a short essay on rainfall and crop yield.
The analyst decided to explain the trend in a memo about monthly sales.
We measured the enzyme activity at a higher temperature to compare the samples.
Using a spreadsheet, she summarized the survey responses in a paragraph.
Students should calculate the velocity of the falling ball after two seconds.
The report includes a description of patient ages at diagnosis.
To compare the groups, he ran a t-test on the reaction times.
The software lets you export the relationship as a list of correlations.

notes: Card: peaks on ' a' before scale/mosaic plot/graph; output promotes ' plot', ' graph', ' visualization'.
